description: This is a Perl module implementing authentication callback functions for SVN in the context of Git integration (git-svn). It defines various subroutines to handle username, password, SSL certificate acceptance, and trust prompts to facilitate SVN authentication flows.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles basic SVN authentication by setting username and password based on provided credentials or prompts.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Manages SSL server trust prompts, displaying certificate details and user options to accept or reject, with handling for various failure conditions.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts the user for a client SSL certificate file path and sets it in credentials.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for the password for the SSL client certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts the user for their username or uses a predefined one, and stores it in credentials.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Helper function that prompts for a password securely.
